tagline: Building the first and only global Cellular Broadband network in space accessible directly by everyday smartphones
hero_kpi_rationale: ASTS is positioned on a unique asset: access to critical satellite frequency bands essential for its business model of cellular connectivity from space.

kpis.name: Acquired satellite spectrum
kpis.explanation: Amount of satellite spectrum the company has secured for its operations.
kpis.description: The company has secured usage rights for 45 MHz of spectrum in the mid-band in the United States and Canada through an agreement with Ligado, and an additional 60 MHz through the acquisition of an entity holding global priority S-Band rights.
kpis.signal: Secured a key asset for network deployment.

kpis.name: Mobile Network Operator partnerships
kpis.explanation: Number of mobile network operator partners for service distribution.
kpis.description: The company has established partnerships with over 50 mobile operators, representing nearly 3 billion subscribers worldwide.
kpis.signal: Extensive potential distribution network for the service.

kpis.name: Patent portfolio
kpis.explanation: Number of patents and patent applications held by the company.
kpis.description: The intellectual property portfolio includes approximately 3,850 patent applications and officially granted or allowed patents worldwide, covering 38 patent families.
kpis.signal: Protection of key intellectual property for the technology.

kpis.name: Global footprint (facilities)
kpis.explanation: Total area of the company's facilities worldwide.
kpis.description: The company has a global footprint of approximately 450,000 square feet, including engineering and development centers in the United States, India, Scotland, Spain, and Israel.
kpis.signal: Physical infrastructure for development and operations.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, value extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Revenue of 0.07 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 5.01 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 2.24 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of 2.34 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Block 2 satellite antenna
kpis.explanation: Size of the phased-array network antenna deployed on next-generation satellites.
kpis.description: Block 2 BB satellites feature a phased-array of approximately 2,400 square feet, more than three times larger than Block 1 satellites, designed for bandwidth capacity up to ten times higher.
kpis.signal: Significantly enhanced antenna capacity for the service.

kpis.name: Block 2 satellite throughput
kpis.explanation: Expected data throughput capacity per beam for Block 2 satellites.
kpis.description: With the introduction of the AST5000 ASIC chip, Block 2 BB satellites are expected to achieve a throughput capacity of 40 MHz per beam, supporting peak data rates of 120 Mbps.
kpis.signal: Major increase in data transmission capacity.
